description: Ablation Run 7 governance-layer comparison, 2026-08-24. Four synthetic clients (CLIENT_SCENARIOS) onboarded against the seed policy (ppo_policy.pt) via PolicyOrchestrator.onboard(), with LLM governance review (_governance_review, Ollama gemma4:12b-it-qat) enabled. fine_tune_steps=2000, train_new_steps=8000, max_samples=300, eval_n_runs=1.

reviews.justification: The seed policy exceeds all requirements for the client's bursty scenario, making reuse an optimal and cost-effective choice.
The seed model significantly exceeds all requirements, making reuse the most cost-effective and safe choice.
The seed policy's sla_violation_rate of 1.00 significantly exceeds the maximum allowed threshold of 0.15.
The 'seed' policy meets all requirements and is a viable reuse candidate.

note: The deterministic-rule-only decision for client_babcock (governance review disabled) was fine_tune -- see the identical decisions dict in the earlier meta-policy comparison run referenced in option-b-meta-policy-failure-2026-08-24.md.
